question: After correcting the frozen evaluator's native-readback identities to the exact source-derived Godot real_t and full-precision JSON projections, does the unchanged one-world, four-cell, one-step R24D12 physical question produce a complete valid finite positive or negative braking-mechanism result?
scope: One native zero-gravity Godot/Jolt world, one build, four isolated one-hinge cells, one exact solver step, and four retained samples. This remains a finite development mechanism characterization and cannot establish numerical accuracy, profile promotion, recovery, prone-to-standing, robustness, equivalence, or release authority.

prior_precedent.precedent_interpretation: R24D5 identified the exact native full-precision representation mismatch, while R24D6 and R24D7 prospectively declared and exercised source-derived real_t projections. R24D13 applies that already-known representation rule to this distinct successor; it does not repair or reinterpret R24D12.

exact_representation_contract.derivation: Pack the authored binary64 value 0.05 to IEEE-754 little-endian binary32, unpack that exact binary32 value, promote it to the evaluator's binary64 number, and require Godot JSON.stringify with full_precision=true to emit the same value.

native_serializer_projection_contract.derivation_rule: For an exact native readback, first derive the pinned Godot real_t binary32 value, then use the pinned runtime's JSON.stringify full_precision=true output as the serialized identity consumed by the evaluator. A shorter decimal is accepted only when it is the runtime-emitted round-trip text for the same binary32 value; no tolerance is introduced.

development_calibration.failure_interpretation: The first zero-object development pass proved the worker and native serializer path but exposed that the R24D12 evaluator also froze the promoted binary32 impulse and timestep values instead of the exact decimals emitted and reparsed through the pinned full-precision Godot serializer.

production_zero_world_route: generate a complete evaluator-shaped template from the frozen evaluator as a schema oracle
launch the exact retained custom Godot runtime with the production project staging and worker
construct no physics bodies, joints, spaces, viewports, or worlds
obtain child inertia through the R24D13 rig description's native real_t Vector3 storage
construct a complete evaluator-shaped report directly in GDScript with explicit integer Variant fields
serialize that report through the same full-precision JSON writer used by the physical route
independently evaluate the serialized report with the frozen R24D13 evaluator
retain the report, evaluation, logs, receipt, and content-addressed artifacts

runtime_freeze.reuse_scope: Exact unchanged native runtime bytes only. No physical result, evaluator outcome, mechanism witness, or campaign conclusion is reused.

mechanism_witness_rule.motor_enabled_cell_rule: The exact pre-step scene and PhysicsServer canonical rate readbacks equal the declared nonzero real_t projection; the retained current native sample has nonzero signed motor impulse opposing that rate, positive absorbed motor work, and negative net motor work.
mechanism_witness_rule.motor_disabled_cell_rule: The exact pre-step scene and PhysicsServer canonical rate readbacks equal the paired declared nonzero real_t projection; signed impulse, positive work, absorbed work, and net work are all exactly zero.
mechanism_witness_rule.positive_outcome: Both signed enabled cells and both paired disabled controls satisfy their frozen mechanism rules.
mechanism_witness_rule.negative_outcome: The exact finite execution is valid but one or more mechanism witnesses are absent.
mechanism_witness_rule.invalid_outcome: The source, runtime, fixture, activation, exact-step, representation, identity, refusal, serializer, or report-shape contract is violated.

adequacy.threshold_provenance: No empirical threshold is selected. Exact IEEE-754 representation, strict nonzero direction and work signs, and exact disabled-control zeros are source- or contract-derived identities.
adequacy.zero_world_gate_adequacy: The zero-object gate executes the exact production worker, custom runtime, native real_t storage, full-precision serializer, report builder, evaluator, supervisor termination protocol, and artifact publication. It proves the path that invalidated R24D12 without predicting either physical outcome.
adequacy.physics_ghost_adequacy: No shortened physics ghost is required. The physical question is already the minimum one-step four-cell execution; any physics ghost would duplicate the same finite exposure. The nonphysical native-serialization route is the code-waste check.
adequacy.cohort_argument: The four cells are the complete frozen fixture, not a sample from a population. One exact step is adequate only for this finite mechanism question.
